claims.statement: Management expects blended average gross margins to remain within the range of 14.5%, 15%, and 15.5%.
claims.quote: I think 14.5%, 15%, 15.5%, those are the kind of ranges we play in from a gross margin standpoint. You have to look at a blended gross margin.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management aims to build fulfilment centres in large towns quickly to enable deliveries within 12 hours for DMart Ready.
claims.quote: We should do whatever it takes to build fulfilment centres in large towns quickly, as quickly as possible so that we are able to deliver in at least 12 hours. I mean, that's the aspiration.
claims.speaker: management

claims.statement: Management states that the current financial year's general merchandise and apparel (GMA) contribution will be equal to or better than FY 2024.
claims.quote: With a reasonable confidence, I can say that, this financial year will be equal to or better than FY '24 GMA contribution.
claims.speaker: management
claims.target: Equal to or better than FY24 GMA contribution

facts.statement: 29 percent of DMart's store cohorts are located in towns with a population of less than 5 lakh.
facts.quote: So, we have 29% of our store cohorts in less than 5 lakh population towns.

facts.statement: The DMart Ready e-commerce business currently runs at an EBITDA loss of minus 2% to minus 3%.
facts.quote: EBITDA margin is still minus 2% to minus 3%.

facts.statement: MMR (Mumbai Metropolitan Region) is fully covered by DMart Ready except for a couple of unserviceable pin codes.
facts.quote: MMR, Mumbai Metropolitan Region, we are fully covered.
